countries.reasoning: Statista 2023 Polyethylene production data corroborated by Plasteurope; China produced ~35 Mt in 2023, representing 38% of global output, with reliable statistics.

Plasteurope 2023 indicates ~6.7 Mt from Russian plants, about 7.3% of global supply; data reliable despite recent sanctions.
